environment.description: Deployment webhook service running on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) in a public subnet with direct internet-facing ALB. Instance role has AmazonEC2FullAccess for managing deployment targets. The WEBHOOK_SECRET environment variable is empty (unset) as the team relies on 'network-level security'. Flask runs as root user via systemd unit. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB, and ALB forwards to port 8080. No additional request filtering or inspection layers.
